liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Green Green Grass of Home** (1 review): Garcia played pedal steel on this and the next tune [15]
- **Doin' That Rag** (1 review): Named by the reviewer as a highlight [17]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): An acoustic guitar seems to be played at the start of this performance [7]
- **The Eleven** (1 review): Reviewer calls this performance awesome [8]
- **Turn On Your Lovelight** (1 review): Weird, funny version: Bobby does man-on-the-street interviews, odd voices sing into the mic, and Pigpen tries to get Mickey singing [8]

## Setlist highlights

- **Mountains Of The Moon**: rare: 14 archived performances [18]
- **Green Green Grass of Home**: rare: 8 archived performances [18]
- **Slewfoot**: rare: 9 archived performances [18]

## The recordings

- **gd69-07-12.sbd-aud.hanno.4645.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 12 songs; 103 min; rated 3/5 by 12 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the recording quality rough and says only completists will want it; First disc sounds awful; second disc from Dark Star onward is as good as the previous day's tape; First seven songs are distorted, poor audience-recording audio; the last five songs are clearer, with some tape issues [6][7][9][11][12]
- **gd1969-07-12.153554.aud.flac1644**: audience recording; 11 songs; 92 min [2]. Said about its sound: Sounds similar to the audience portions of 4644/4645, with many drop-outs and tape anomalies but still listenable [2]
- **gd1969-07-12.123433.sbd.latvala-lee-smith.flac24**: soundboard; 5 songs; 62 min; rated 3/5 by 3 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer hopes a lost soundboard of the first set exists [13]
- **gd1969-07-12.123434.sbd.latvala-lee-smith.flac16**: soundboard; 5 songs; 62 min; rated 2/5 by 2 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer hopes a lost soundboard of the first set exists [14]

## Around the show

- The band sounds very high and seems to be having a ball [8]
- Reviewer's first show: the Dead headlined, with Joe Cocker and the Grease Band second on the bill [15]
- Grease Band opened with two instrumentals, then Cocker's first song was She Came In Through the Bathroom Window [15]
- Show pairs with the July 11 tape to make a nice three-disc set [7]
- Second disc is less hissy than the July 11, 1969 tape [9]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-07-12.sbd-aud.hanno.4645.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Hanno Bunjes; source: Disc 1: Audience; Disc 2: Soundboard [1]. Also: Deadlists suggests the Doin' That Rag through High Time stretch may be a soundboard with bad levels; uploader hears an audience tape [1]
- **gd1969-07-12.153554.aud.flac1644**: taped by From the collection of Rich Petrunis.; transferred by Transferred by Andrew F. 09/2021; source: Unknown mono AUD [2]. Also: Derived from mix-tapes containing parts of both nights, with more material than the 4644/4645 versions [2]
- **gd1969-07-12.123433.sbd.latvala-lee-smith.flac24**: taped by Dick Latvala, Pat Lee; transferred by Matt Smith; source: Partial SBD Recording Info: Pat Lee from Dick Latvala 1985; Technics 1506> Yamaha K2000 MSC > R > C > CD; Transfer Info: Mastered via the Apogee Mini Me(24/96)… [3]
- **gd1969-07-12.123434.sbd.latvala-lee-smith.flac16**: taped by Dick Latvala, Pat Lee; transferred by Matt Smith; source: Partial SBD Recording Info: Pat Lee from Dick Latvala 1985; Technics 1506> Yamaha K2000 MSC > R > C > CD; Transfer Info: Mastered via the Apogee Mini Me(24/96)… [4]
